question: Compare the agriculture/fishing and manufacturing panels in Figure 5.11 between 2010 and 2020. Which sector loses workers and which gains, and what skill color dominates agriculture?
answer:
Between 2010 and 2020 in Figure 5.11, the agriculture and fishing sector loses workers (decreasing from around 24 million down to about 17.5 million), whereas the manufacturing sector gains workers (increasing from about 7 million to roughly 11.5 million). [p161-figure-5.11]

The skill color that dominates the agriculture and fishing sector is yellow (representing unskilled manual), followed by grey (representing skilled manual). [p161-figure-5.11]
